primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Derived metrics — live coverage ("stats we have that they don't") Single source of truth: `apps/web/lib/metrics/coverage-map.ts` (typed, clearance-gated — a metric only counts as live coverage if its source clears `checkClearance()` for the commercial/derived use).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C': 'Coverage set, dimensionless', 'S': 'Source set, dimensionless', 'T': 'Trust score, [0,1]', 'G': 'Clearance gate function, boolean'}
primitives.assumptions: Each metric is a function of source trust and clearance status; coverage is binary per source.

layer2.mapping: Lattice structure maps to Bayesian network nodes where each node represents a source's contribution to coverage under trust constraints.

primitives.name: Trust Conflict Resolution
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Brutal audit - CRITICAL: active, legally usable data coverage remains smaller than the seeded source universe.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T_i': 'Trust level of source i, [0,1]', 'F_i': 'Conflict flag for source i, boolean', 'R': 'Resolution function, {0,1}'}
primitives.assumptions: Conflicts arise when T_i < threshold and F_i = true; resolution requires external validation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: R(T_i, F_i) = 0 when T_i < τ and F_i = true

layer2.mapping: Kernel computes trust-weighted average of conflicting sources, resolving via legal clearance.
layer2.telemetry: Number of resolved conflicts and post-resolution trust scores

primitives.name: UX Comprehension Layer
primitives.verbatim_quote: - HIGH: premium UX must explain trust, coverage, conflicts, and missing data in ten seconds.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'U': 'User comprehension score, [0,1]', 'T_c': 'Time to comprehension, seconds', 'M': 'Metric set, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: U is inversely proportional to T_c and directly correlated with clarity of trust/conflict indicators.

layer2.mapping: Kernel models UX efficiency through metric presentation and trust visualization.
layer2.telemetry: Average time to understand coverage and trust per user session
